Editor shortcuts
Tab accept suggestion · Ctrl+Space suggest
Ctrl+P open file · Ctrl+F find · Ctrl+H replace
Ctrl+Z undo · Ctrl+Shift+Z redo
F5 debug/continue · F10 step · F9 breakpoint
Shift+F5 stop · F8/Shift+F8 problems
F12 go to definition · Ctrl+click peek references
Shift+F12 find references · F2 rename symbol
Alt+← go back · Ctrl+G go to line
Ctrl+/ comment · Alt+↑/↓ move line
Ctrl+Shift+K delete line · Ctrl+Tab switch tabs
Ctrl+W close tab · Middle-click a tab to close it

Browser-safe alternatives:
Alt+Shift+G line · Alt+Shift+H replace
Alt+Shift+F find · Alt+Shift+P open file
Alt+Shift+W close tab · Alt+PageUp/Down switch tabs
Alt+Shift+B compile · Alt+Shift+L save
Alt+Shift+D debug/continue · Alt+Shift+S step
Alt+Shift+X stop
